provenance.benchmark_hash_verification: sha256 of docs/phase_m1d/M1_D_Benchmark_Freeze.json re-computed at every driver start and matched against archived results/phase_m1d/* benchmark_freeze_hash fields before any run
provenance.frozen_base_covariance_source: read from frozen proposal metadata (unit I_2 family of hyptraj.m1.proposal_update.MixtureProposal); code must NOT hardcode the value without checking metadata (task Sec. 13)

protocol_locked.pilot_rng_rule: np.random.default_rng([seed, 101]); frozen draw_mix_pilot order (target first, then current proposal)

cost_accounting.budget_total_declared: n_pilot * adaptation_rounds + final_eval_n (= 120000 for one-birth trials, identical to M1-D d1 trials)

selection_policy_locked.selector: frozen M1-D variance selector: eligible_candidates (Sec. 16 gate, min_mode_observations=5, no birth-threshold prefilter) then argmax L_hat (Sec. 17.2)
selection_policy_locked.selection_lock: selected mode computed EXACTLY ONCE per (config, seed) from the shared pilot; C0-C4 all reuse it (task Sec. 19)
selection_policy_locked.mean_lock: all variants share m_eta=0.8,k^V = frozen variance-mass HDR centroid (task Sec. 20); no variant may recompute a different centroid
selection_policy_locked.cross_check_anchor: results/phase_m1d/d1_selection_only/layer_a_one_birth_v1.json method=variance_selector records use the same pilot stream rng=[seed,101]; M2 drivers verify equality of the selected mode offline (audit only, never feeds back online)

covariance_family_locked.C0_frozen_base: Sigma_base read from frozen proposal metadata (expected unit I_2)
covariance_family_locked.C1_isotropic_scale: s_V^2 * I, s_V^2 = tr(C_eta)/d, then legality projection
covariance_family_locked.C4_shrunk_full_MAIN: (1 - lambda) * Sigma_base + lambda * C_eta, lambda_main = 0.50, then legality projection

ess_hold_rule_locked.hold_action: HOLD_BASE_COVARIANCE -> Sigma_new = Sigma_base (recorded as finite-sample HOLD behavior, NOT a failed trial)
ess_hold_rule_locked.scope: gate applies to C1/C2/C3/C4 construction inside each trial; C0 unaffected by definition

legality_gate_locked.projection: Sigma = U diag(clip(eig_j, 0.55, 4.00)) U^T applied AFTER candidate construction, BEFORE use
legality_gate_locked.frozen_checker: reuse hyptraj.m1.proposal_update LEGALITY_MIN_EIG discipline (min eig >= 0.5) as second-stage check; never redefine an inconsistent version

two_layers_locked.layer_A_shape_only: pi = pi_C0 from frozen M1-D update for ALL variants; isolated covariance effect
two_layers_locked.layer_B_shape_reweight: each candidate refit by the SAME frozen SLSQP weight optimizer on the declared pilot fit data; headline performance layer
two_layers_locked.weight_optimizer: hyptraj.m1.mixture_weights.optimize_mixture_weights (SLSQP, analytic gradient, ftol=1e-12, maxiter=500, floor=0) -- UNMODIFIED

gates_locked.M2_0_validity: parent tags unchanged; benchmark hash matched; selection lock; mean lock; source density correct; covariance SPD; frozen legality checker pass; no final-eval leakage; full pytest exit 0; no missing result cells; estimator probability consistency
gates_locked.M2_1_estimator_stability: >= 7/8 configs median-trial {ESS_V_region >= 20 or legal HOLD; covariance finite; projection finite; no systematic NaN/singularity}; report HOLD frequency
gates_locked.M2_2_core_second_moment_gain: median_config[median_seed M2(C4)/M2(C0)] <= 0.85 AND >= 6/8 configs median_seed M2(C4) < median_seed M2(C0)
gates_locked.M2_5_relative_budget_efficiency: median VRF_budget(C4) > median VRF_budget(C0) AND median VRF_budget(C4)/VRF_budget(C0) >= 1.25

ablations_locked.F_ess_stratification: covariance gain stratified by low/medium/high ESS_V_region

isotropic_vs_anisotropic_gate.comparison: C4 vs C1, >= 5/8 configs per-config median M2(C4) < M2(C1) supports anisotropy claim; otherwise conclusion tightens to scale effect (not a main-method failure)
